_comment: POBP codes: check the PUMS data dictionary for your vintage (ours is 2024). Origin shares: SENAFRONT/SNM Darien irregular-transit counts by nationality (raw counts or shares; they are renormalised to the groups listed). The first origin is the calibration reference.

origin_shares._source: Servicio Nacional de Migracion (Panama), Transito irregular por Darien, Cuadro No. 003, year 2022 (Dec 2022 release). Raw counts, Jan-Sep 2022 sum (total 151,582 entries; Venezuela 71.05%). Renormalised to the groups listed.

crossover._comment: Fine run around the first-pass crossover (138-277): denser grid between 120 and 400, 200 replicates. Coarse first pass (default sizes, 50 replicates) is in data/sprint3/.
